channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: US CPI data expected to show inflation rose further in May, reinforcing bets of Fed rate hikes
item.description: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) will publish the May Consumer Price Index (CPI) data on Wednesday. The report is expected to show another step up in consumer inflation, driven by the persistently high Oil prices due to the ongoing crisis in the Middle East.

item.title: British Pound gains ground to near 1.3400 ahead of US CPI release
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.3390 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. Markets might turn cautious later in the day ahead of the US May Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation report.

item.title: USD/CNH Price Forecast: More downside likely below 6.7500
item.description: The USD/CNH pair trades slightly lower to near 6.7750 during the early European trading session on Wednesday. The pair faces selling pressure due to continued outperformance by the Chinese Yuan (CNY), being a trade surplus economy.

item.title: Iran's Araghchi warns Gulf states have legal and moral responsibility to prevent US, Israeli strikes
item.description: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi warned that its neighbours in the Gulf have a “legal and moral responsibility” to prevent American and Israeli strikes, the Guardian reported on Wednesday.

item.title: Gold hits fresh low since March as inflation fears lift hawkish rate bets ahead of US CPI
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) attracts heavy follow-through selling on Wednesday and weakens further below the $4,200 mark, hitting a fresh low since March 23 during the Asian session.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Flat lines below $87.50 as bears await 100-day SMA breakdown
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – struggles to capitalize on a modest Asian session uptick and currently trades just below mid-$87.00s, nearly unchanged for the day.

item.title: Japanese Yen languishes despite wholesale inflation accelerates in May
item.description: USD/JPY flatlines after experiencing volatility, trading around 160.40 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair continues to hold its ground, reflecting a struggling Japanese Yen (JPY) that has failed to find support despite a massive acceleration in wholesale inflation.

item.title: BoJ expected to raise interest rates to 1.0% in June meeting - Reuters poll
item.description: A Reuters poll showed on Wednesday that roughly two-thirds of economists expect the Bank of Japan (BoJ) to hike the policy rate to 1.50% by the second quarter (Q2) next year. That brings forward the expectations of such a target, which was projected for Q3 next year in May.

item.title: Indian Rupee flattens while flaring US-Iran tensions dampen outlook
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens almost flat against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Strengthens above 185.00, while bullish trend eyes consolidation
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross gathers strength to near 185.20 during the early European session on Wednesday. The Euro (EUR) edges higher against the Japanese Yen (JPY) amid expectations that the European Central Bank (ECB) would raise rates at its June policy meeting on Thursday.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Consolidates above 0.7000/two-month low; bearish potential intact
item.description: The AUD/USD pair oscillates in a narrow range during the Asian session on Wednesday and moves little following the release of mixed inflation figures from China.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Jordan says Iranian missiles intercepted before reaching their targets
item.description: Jordanian armed forces said that they intercepted and shot down five missiles launched from Iran toward the al-Azraq area in Jordan, the Guardian reported on Wednesday.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Flattens around 1.1545 ahead of US Inflation data
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades in a tight range around 1.1545 during the Asian trading session on Wednesday. The major currency pair consolidates as the US Dollar (USD) trades calmly ahead of the United States (US) Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for May, which will be published at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Swiss Franc remains subdued as traders adopt caution due to Middle East concerns
item.description: USD/CHF extends its gains for the fourth successive day, trading around 0.7990 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair may further appreciate as the safe-haven demand could support the US Dollar (USD), which could be attributed to the renewed Middle East tensions.

item.title: United States Dollar Index posts modest gains to near 100.00 amid rising Middle East tensions
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 100.00 during the Asian trading hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD bears retain control near March lows, below $64.50
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) attracts some follow-through sellers for the second consecutive day and drops to its lowest level since March 23 during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar steadies as oil prices rise
item.description: USD/CAD inches higher after posting minor gains in the previous day, trading around 1.3950 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: British Pound consolidates below 1.3400 vs USD amid fresh Iran tensions, ahead of US CPI
item.description: The GBP/USD pair struggles to capitalize on its recovery gains recorded over the past two days, from a three-week low, and oscillates in a narrow band during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar holds steady on mixed China's inflation releases, US CPI data looms
item.description: The NZD/USD pair holds steady around 0.7030 during the Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) steadies against the US Dollar (USD) following China’s economic data. All eyes will be on the US May Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation report later on Wednesday.

item.title: China’s CPI inflation misses expectation in May: What 1.2% means for the Australian Dollar
item.description: China’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) climbed 1.2% in May from a year ago after arriving at a rise of 1.2% in April, the National Bureau of Statistics of China reported on Wednesday. The market consensus was for 1.3% in the reported period.

item.title: Japanese Yen hangs near one-month low vs USD as Mideast tensions counter strong PPI print
item.description: The USD/JPY pair enters a bullish consolidation phase during the Asian session on Wednesday and moves little following the release of Japan's stronger-than-expected Producer Price Index (PPI).

item.title: WTI steadies around $87.50 despite renewed supply concerns
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price experiences volatility after registering over 2.5% losses in the previous day, trading around $87.40 per barrel during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.8130 vs. 6.8147 previous
item.description: On Wednesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.8130 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.8147 and 6.7749 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Australian Dollar declines ahead of China CPI data
item.description: AUD/USD extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 0.7020 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. Traders will likely await the release of Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Producer Price Index (PPI) data for May from China, Australia’s close trading partner, due later in the day.

item.title: Euro edges lower below 1.1550 as US launches self-defense strikes against Iran
item.description: The EUR/USD pair loses momentum to near 1.1540 during the early Asian session on Wednesday. Renewed tensions in the Middle East following the US attack on Iran drag the Euro (EUR) lower against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Iran's Araghchi: Powerful armed forces will not ignore any attack or threat
item.description: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi warned the United States (US) to leave the region or face consequences, adding that Iran's armed forces would not leave any attack or threat unanswered.

item.title: Gold slumps below $4,250 on renewed US-Iran tensions, US CPI data in focus
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) attracts some sellers to around $4,235, the lowest since March 23, during the early Asian session on Wednesday. The precious metal extends its downside on renewed tensions in the Middle East and rising expectations of a US interest rate hike this year.

item.title: British Pound Sterling tries retail therapy, hits the usual ceiling
item.description: Sterling finally got a piece of good domestic news and managed to enjoy it for about half a session. GBP/USD rallied from just below 1.3350 to a touch above 1.3400 on Tuesday, tagged the 200-day Exponential Moving Average (EMA), and spent the rest of the day leaking back beneath the figure.

item.title: Japanese Yen round-trips Tokyo's record intervention just in time for CPI
item.description: Six weeks ago Japan reportedly spent a record sum dragging this pair off exactly this shelf.
